name: Parallel review, testing, and evidence
userOutcome: The user can see independent reviews and deterministic checks start as soon as work is ready and understand exactly which evidence permits or blocks acceptance.
productionDataSource: Implementation outputs, review policy, test commands, reviewer runs, findings, artifacts, and completion reports.
errorBehavior: Keep successful evidence, identify unavailable and failed checks separately, and prevent acceptance until required evidence or an approved waiver exists.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not accept author self-review as the only required review.
Do not report a missing check as passed.
Do not store large binary artifacts directly in SQLite.
acceptanceTests: Fan out code, test, and specification reviews.
Accept after all required evidence passes.
